songs.title: Abide with me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Abide with me, fast falls the eventide;
The darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide,
When other helpers fail, and comforts flee
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day;
Earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away
Change and decay in all around I see
O thou who changest not,
abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
I need thy presence every passing hour
What but thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who like thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine,
O abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
I fear no foe, with thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
Where is death's sting?
Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if thou abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 5

sections.content:
Ah! Lord God, thou has made the heavens and the earth by Thy Great power
Ah! Lord God, thou hast made the heavens and the earth by Thy outstretched arms
Nothing is too difficult for thee!
Nothing is too difficult for thee!

O Great and mighty God
Great in counsel and mighty in deed
Nothing, nothing, Absolutely nothing
Nothing is too difficult for thee.
Key Chance

songs.title: All hail the power of Jesu's name!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
All hail the power of Jesu's name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Crown Him, ye martyrs of our God,
Who from His altar call;
Extol the stem of Jesse's rod,
And crown him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Ye chosen seed of Israel's race,
And remnant weak and small,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Ye Gentile sinners, ne'er forget
The wormwood and the gall;
Go, spread your trophies at His feet,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Let every kindred, every tribe
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall,
Join in the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 1

Who can compare
With the beauty of the Lord?

I gladly bow the knee,
And worship him alone

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
I will proclaim
The glory of the risen Lord,
Who once was slain
To reconcile man to God
For ever you will be The lamb upon the throne
I gladly bow the knee
And worship you alone.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
All things praise Thee,
Lord most high
Heaven and earth and sea and sky,
All were for Thy glory made
That Thy greatness thus displayed
Should all worship bring to Thee;
All things praise thee: Lord may we

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
All things praise Thee;
high and low,
Rain and dew and seven-hued bow,
Crimson sunset, fleecy cloud,
Rippling stream and tempest loud;
Summer, winter, all to Thee
Glory render, Lord, may we.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
All things praise Thee;
gracious Lord,
Great Creator, powerful Word,
Omnipresent Spirit, now
At Thy feet we humbly bow
Lift our hearts in praise to thee;
All things praise Thee; Lord
may we. Amen

songs.title: All to Jesus I surrender

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
All to Jesus I surrender
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live

I surrender all...
I surrender all...
All to Thee, my blessed
Saviour
I surrender all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
All to Jesus I surrender
Humbly at His feet I bow
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me Jesus, take me now.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
All to Jesus I surrender
Lord, I give myself to thee;

Fill me with Thy love and power
Let Thy blessing fall on me

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
All to Jesus I surrender
Now I feel the sacred flame;
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory to His Name!

songs.title: Alleluia, Alleluia

sections.content:
Alleluia, Alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty
reigns
Alleluia, Alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Alleluia, Holy
Holy are You Lord God
Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb
Worthy is the Lamb

You are holy
Holy are You Lord God
Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb
Worthy is the Lamb
Amen
Agnus Dei

songs.title: Amazing grace

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now I’m found
Was blind but now I see

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
’Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,

And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear,
The hour I first believed!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Thro’ many dangers, toils, and snares,
I have already come;
Tis grace hath brought me safe thus Far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
The Lord has promised good to me
His word my hope secures.
He will my shield and portion be As long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
And when this flesh and heart shall fail
And mortal life shall cease
I shall possess within the veil
A life of joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
When we’ve been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,

We’ve no less days to sing

God’s grace,
Than when we first began.

songs.title: Amen, Amen, Blessings and Glory

sections.content:
Amen, Amen, Blessings and

Glory

Wisdom, thanksgiving and

honour

Power and might be unto our

God
For ever and ever, Amen!
Antwi Bekoe - PH 260

songs.title: Ancient fire at work in us

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Ancient fire at work in us
Ancient fire will never die
The fire from above
The Pentecost fire
The fire set in me

The fire set in you
The Pentecost fire will ever burn

The fire set in me, I will fan it up
The fire set in you, you should fan it up

The fire will impact generations
The Pentecost fire will never die

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Ancient fire at work in us
Ancient fire will never die
The burning bush fire

The light in the temple

That which burns in my soul

That which lights up my path

The Pentecost fire will set

ablaze

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Ancient fire at work in us
Ancient fire will never die
Fire from the Father
That which led Israel
The fire that leads me
The fire that leads you
The Pentecost fire will lead us on

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Ancient fire at work in us
Ancient fire will never die
The promise of Jesus
The Holy Ghost Fire

The fire that gives life
Is what is set in us
The Pentecost fire will make us live

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Ancient fire at work in me
Ancient fire will never die
The storms may rage
The waves may flood
The fire set ahead
The fire set behind
The Pentecost fire will see me through
Translation of “Tete gya no r’y1 adwuma” - Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: And can it be

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
And can it be, that I should gain
An interest in the saviour's blood?
Died he for me, who caused his pain?
For me, who him to death pursued?
Amazing love! how can it be That thou, my God should die for me?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
'Tis mystery all! The

immortal dies!

Who can explore his strange

design?

In vain the first born seraph tries
To sound the depth of love divine
'Tis' mercy all! let earth adore,

Let angel-minds inquire no

more.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
He left His father's throne above!
(So free, so infinite His grace,)
Emptied himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race;
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,

For, O my God , it found out me!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Long my imprisoned spirit lay
Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
Thine eye diffused a quickening ray
I woke, dungeon flamed with

light;
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth and followed

thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
No condemnation now I dread,
Jesus, and all in him, is mine!
Alive in him, my living head,
And clothed in righteousness

divine,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through
Christ my own

songs.title: Ar-ise, shine

sections.content:
Ar-ise, shine, still move forward
In vic-tory
For the Lord your God is with you
And you will never fail
Still move forward
Translation of "S4re Hyer1n"
Eunice Johnson's

songs.title: As a father who so loved me

sections.content:
As a father who so loved me,
That you gave Jesus for my life
Now I bear fruit for your service
Let your beauty be seen in me
I give you all my life
I give you all my life
Your grace is sufficient for me
Let your beauty be seen in me.
E.K. Asamoah

songs.title: As I live; I will praise you

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.content:
As I breathe I will praise you;
As I breathe; my heart will worship;
For you are God; For you are
God
Holy is the Lord our God; (x3)
For you are God; For you are
God
Daniel Akakpo

songs.title: As the deer panteth for the waters

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
As the deer panteth for the waters
So my soul panteth after Thee
You alone are my heart’s desire
And I long to worship you.

You alone are my strength and shield
To you alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my heart’s desire
And I long to worship you.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
I want you more than gold or silver

Only you can satisfy
You alone are the real joy giver
And the apple of my eye.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
You are my friend and you are my brother
Even though you are a King
I love you more than any

other
So much more than anything
Martin Nystrom

songs.title: Away far over Jordan

sections.content:
Away far over Jordan
We'll meet in that land
O won't it be grand!
Away far over Jordan
We'll meet in that beautiful land
So grand!
If you get there before I do,
Please tell my friends that I'm coming too,
Away far over Jordan
We'll meet in that beautiful land
So grand!

songs.title: Be gone, unbelief

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Be gone, unbelief,

My saviour is near,

And for my relief

Will surely appear;
By prayer let me wrestle,
And He will perform;

With Christ in the vessel,
I smile at the storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Though dark be my way,
Since He is my Guide,
‘Tis mine to obey,

‘Tis His to provide;
Though cisterns be broken,
And creatures all fail,
The word He has spoken
Shall surely prevail

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
His love in time past,
Forbids me to think
He’ll leave me at last
In trouble to sink:
While each Ebenezer
I have in review
Confirms His good pleasure
To help me quite through

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Why should I complain
Of want or distress,
Temptation or pain?

He told me no less;
The heirs of salvation,
I know from His Word,

Through much tribulation
Must follow their Lord

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
How bitter that cup
No heart can conceive,
Which He drank quite up,
That sinners might live!
His way was much rougher
And darker than mine;

Did Christ, my Lord, suffer,
And shall I repine?

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Since all that I meet
Shall work for my good,
The bitter is sweet,
The medicine, food;
Though painful at present,
‘T will cease before long,
And then, oh, how pleasant
The conqueror’s song!

songs.title: Be steadfast and Immovable

sections.content:
Be steadfast and Immovable
Abounding in the work of the Lord
Your labour won’t be in vain
And your reward will be great.
Translation of “Montintim, mma monhinhim da”
Grace Gakpetor

songs.title: Be still, my soul

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.content:
Be still, my soul, thy God

doth undertake

To guide the future as he has

the past

Thy hope, thy confidence let

nothing shake

All now mysterious shall be
bright at last
Be still, my soul; the waves and winds still know
His voice who ruled them while he dwelt below

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Be still, my soul; when dearest friend depart
And all is darkened in the vale of tears
Then shalt thou better know his love, his heart
Who comes to soothe thy sorrow and thy fears
Be still, my soul, thy Jesus can repay
From his own fullness, all he takes away.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Be still, my soul; the hour is hastening on When we shall be forever with the Lord.

When disappointment, grief
and fear are gone

Sorrow forgot, love's purest
joys restored

Be still, my soul, when
change and tears are past
All safe and blessed we shall
meet at last

songs.title: Beautiful Nazarene

sections.content:
Beautiful Nazarene
Wonderful friend of mine
Oh let me gaze on thee
Thou Son of God divine

sections.content:
Behold he comes, in power and glory
Here comes, the Christ our king (x2)

Has gloriously been crowned, in the heavenly realms
His angels worship him, and the saints adore him
Behold he comes, in power and glory
Here comes, the Christ our king
Translation of $no na 4reba ‘i
Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: Behold He comes

sections.content:
Behold He comes

Jesus Christ the King

Are you ready to welcome
Him?
Does it mean anything to you?

He is coming to take the saints to heaven

And to reward everyone according to his works
Behold He comes, behold He comes
Meet the saviour in beauty and splendour
Behold He comes, behold He comes

Jesus Christ the coming king.

Elder Emmanuel Asante

songs.title: Bind us together

sections.content:
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together, with cords
That cannot be broken,
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together with love

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
There is only one God
There is only one King

There is only one body

That is why we sing

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Made for the Glory of God
Purchased by his precious
Son

Born with the right to be clean
For Jesus the victory has won

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
You are the family of God
You are the promise divine
You are God's chosen desire.
You are the glorious new wine
Bob Gillman

songs.title: Bless the Lord, O my soul

sections.content:
Bless the Lord, O my soul
Bless the Lord, O my soul
And all that is within me bless His holy name
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
Bless the Lord, O my soul,

And all that is within me bless His holy name.
King of kings forever and ever
Lord of lords forever and ever
King of kings forever and ever
King of kings and Lord of lords

songs.title: Bless the Lord, oh my soul

sections.content:
Bless the Lord, oh my soul (x2)
And all that is within me
Bless His holy name
He has done great things (x3)
Bless His holy name

songs.title: Blessed assurance

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
Oh, what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of his spirit, washed in his blood

This is my story, this is my song
Praising my saviour all the day long

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight,
Angels descending, bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Perfect submission, all is at rest
I in my saviour am happy and blest Watching and waiting, looking above
Filled with his goodness, lost in his love Fanny J. Crosby

songs.title: Blessing and honour be unto You

sections.content:
Blessing and honour be unto You,
Oh Lord, our God
Blessing and honour be unto

you
Oh Lord, our God
You are the Lord of lords

The Only God
The King of kings in the world
We’ll lift up your name
Will praise your name

Declare your glorious works
Blessing and honour be unto you
Oh Lord our God
Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: Blow over me

sections.content:
Blow over me, the breath of God

Sweep over me, the Spirit of God
Change my whole being, transform me

Cause me Lord to do your whole will Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: Break camp! Advance!

sections.content:
Break camp! Advance!
Arise and move on I am always with you Break camp! Advance!
Grace Gakpetor

songs.title: Breathe on me, Breath of God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Breathe on me, Breath of God
Fill me with life anew
That I may love what Thou dost love
And do what Thou wouldst do//

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Breathe on me, Breath of God
Until my heart is pure
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure//

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Breathe on me, Breath of God
Till I am wholly Thine,
Till all this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine//

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Breathe on me, Breath of God so shall I never die
But live with Thee the perfect life Of Thine eternity// Edwin Hatch

songs.title: Brightest and best of the sons of the morning

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Brightest and best of the

sons of the morning

Dawn on our darkness, and lend

us thine aid

Star of the East, the horizon adorning,

Guide where our infant

Redeemer is laid

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Cold on His cradle the

dew-drops are shining

Low lies His head with the

beasts of the stall

Angels adore Him in slumber reclining Maker, and Monarch, and Saviour of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Say, shall we yield Him, in costly devotion Odours of Edom, and offerings divine
Gems of the mountain and pearls of the ocean
Myrrh from the forest or gold from the mine

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Vainly we offer each ample oblation

Vainly with gifts would His favour secure
Richer by far is the heart’s

adoration

Dearer to God are the prayers

of the poor

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Brightest and best of the

sons of the morning

Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid

Star of the East, the horizon

adorning

Guide where our infant

Redeemer is laid

songs.title: Captain of Israel’s host

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Captain of Israel’s host, and guide
Of all who seek the land above,
Beneath Thy shadow we abide
The cloud of Thy protecting love
Our strength, thy grace
Our rule, Thy word
Our end, the glory of the Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
By thine unerring spirit led,
We shall not in the desert stray;
We shall not full direction need,
Nor miss our providential way
As far from danger, as from fear

While love, Almighty love is

near.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
We’ve no abiding city here

But seek a city out of sight
Thither our steady course we

steer
Aspiring to the plains of light

Jerusalem the saints’ abode

Whose founder is the Living

God

Christ is born for us today
Rejoice, Rejoice
Christ is born for us today
Rejoice, Rejoice.
Translation of Wawo Christ ama yεn nnε

songs.title: Christ is risen from the dead

sections.content:
Christ is risen from the dead!
He’s risen, never to die.
O, death, where is your sting?
He’s risen, Hallelujah!
Translation of Yesu Kristo, W’as4re!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Christ is the answer to all our

problems

Christ is the answer to all our needs;

Saviour, Baptiser, the Great

Physician:

O Halleluia! He’s all I need

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Christ is the answer to all

our longings

Christ is the answer to all our needs;

Saviour, Baptiser, the Great
Physician:
O Halleluia! He’s all I need

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Christ is the answer to all our sufferings
Christ is the answer to all our needs;
Saviour, Baptiser, the Great
Physician:
O Halleluia! He’s all I need

songs.title: Christ Our Lord comes

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Christ Our Lord comes
once again
Comes to judge the entire world
Soon He comes, He won’t
delay
Will appear in glory, po-wer
and strength
Soon He comes, He won’t delay
All believers will a-ppear
before Him
To render account of our
stewardship
Soon He comes, He won’t delay
In all my ways I must be
watchful that I do not go astray
Christ will tell me: “Well
done, good servant,” for my
faithful stewardship
Tribulations await all who did not serve Christ the Son of God
A faithful servant I shall be In all my life and forever serve Him

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Christ our Lord comes once again
Comes to judge the entire world
Tell me what your stand will be
The merciful judge will
declare His right judgement
Tell me what your stand will
be
The whole world will a-ppear
before Him
To render account for works
they have done
Tell me what your stand will
be
You must accept Christ as the
Son of God, in order to be
saved
Christ will give you eternal
life, if you truly believe in
Him
Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: Come and dine

sections.content:
Come and dine, Come and dine
You may feast at Jesus’ table all the time,
He, who fed the multitude, turned the water into wine;
To the hungry He calleth now,
Come and dine.
C. B. Widmeyer
P H195

songs.title: Come, let us all rejoice

sections.content:
Come, let us all rejoice! (x2)

Although I was so poor,
But now I have the love of God,
Love much precious than gold!
Translation of Ao, bra ma yεnni dεw

songs.title: Come, ye that love the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Come, ye that love the Lord,

And let your joys be known
Join in a song with sweet accord, (x2)
And thus surround the throne, (x2)

We’re marching to Zion
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We’re marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Let those refuse to sing
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heavenly
King (x2)
Must speak their joys abroad

(x2)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heavenly
fields, (x2)
Or walk the golden streets

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry;
We’re marching through
Emmanuel’s ground (x2)
To fairer worlds on high (x2)

songs.title: Courage, brother!

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.content:
Let the road be rough and dreary,
And its end far out of sight
Foot it bravely! strong or weary,
“Trust in God, and do the right”

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Perish policy and cunning
Perish all that fears the light!

Whether losing, whether winning,
Trust in God, and do the right”

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Simple rule, and safest guiding,
Inward peace, and inward light
Star up our path abiding -

“Trust in God and do the right”

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

songs.title: Crown him with many crowns

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Crown him with many
crowns
The Lamb upon his throne
Hark! How the heavenly
Anthem drowns
All music but its own

Awake; my soul, and sing
Of him who died for thee..
And hail him as thy

matchless King
Through all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Crown him the Son of God
Before the worlds began;
And ye who tread where he
had trod,
Crown him the son of Man

Who every grief hath known
That wrings the human breast
And takes and bears them for
his own,
That all in him may rest

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Crown him the Lord of
love
Behold his hands and side'
Those wounds yet visible
above
In beauty glorified

No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight
But downward bends his

burning eye
At mysteries so bright.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Crown him the Lord of
peace
Whose power a sceptre sways
From pole to pole, that war
may cease
And all be prayer and praise

His reign shall know no end
And round his pierced feet
Fair flowers of paradise
extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Crown him the Lord of
years
The Potentate of time,
Creator of the rolling spheres,
Ineffably sublime;

All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For thou has died for me:
Thy praise shall never, never
fail
Throughout eternity.

songs.title: Crucified with Christ
Day by day

sections.content:
Day by day, dear Lord
For these three things I pray
To see thee more clearly
Love thee more dearly
Follow thee more nearly
Day by day.

songs.title: Declaring what I know

sections.content:
Declaring what I know and what I’ve heard to you
Jesus is life, He gives life
In Him is life always

Doing the work of the Lord,
Publishing his mighty name;
Doing the work of the Lord,
Telling of his love to all,

Sowing the precious seed
Sowing in the morning, sowing in the noon-tide

songs.title: Don't give up yet

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Don't give up yet,
I’m in control
Watching over you to the end
Life may be dark, I’ll be your light
In your weakness, my grace prevails

Look up to me, rely on me
Keep trusting Me, in all you do
Surely My presence is with you
Surely victory will be your end.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Life will be brigh-ter than noon day
Darkness will be-come like morning
If you devote your heart to me
If you stretch your hand to hold mine

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Worry no more, I’m still your God
Your Redeemer, the Mighty One
Giver of life, Eternal God
I will hold you through life’s journey

songs.title: Draw me to the Living stream

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Draw me to the Living stream
Oh Lord
Draw me to the living stream
Draw me to the living stream
Oh Lord
Draw me to the living stream
The living stream of God is flowing now
Flowing through those who wait on Him
Draw me to the living stream
Oh Lord
Draw me to the living stream.

songs.title: Enough is Your grace to me

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Enough is Your grace to me,
O Lord
Your grace is sufficient for me (x2)
You keep me safe in darkest night
You are with me in troubled times
Enough is Your grace to me,
O Lord
Your grace is sufficient for me

songs.title: Everybody ought to love Him

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Everybody ought to love Him,
Everybody, everywhere;
Everybody ought to love Him,
He will banish every care;
He’s the author of salvation,
Condemnation He did bear
Jesus died for every nation
Everybody, everywhere.

songs.title: Exalt the Lord, our God

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Exalt the Lord, our God
Worship at His footstool
For the Lord, our God is Holy (2x)

songs.title: Exalted one is He on the throne

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Exalted one is He on the throne
Around the throne are the heavenly hosts
Bow before Him, the Holy One
The Lord God Almighty is He on the throne He’s worthy of praise

The Lord God Almighty is He on the throne He’s worthy of praise
He is the King of kings
He is the Lord of lords
Jesus Christ is the King of kings

Jesus Christ is the Lord of lords

songs.title: Fairest of all the earth beside

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Fairest of all the earth beside.
Chiefest of all unto thy bride,
Fullness divine in thee I see,
Wonderful man of Calvary

That man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Blest man of Calvary

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Granting the sinner life and peace
Granting the captive sweet release
Shedding his blood to make us free Merciful man of Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Giving the gifts obtained for men
Pouring out love beyond our ken
Giving us spotless purity,
Bountiful man of Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Comfort of all my earthly way
Jesus I’ll meet thee some sweet day;
Centre of glory thee I’ll see
Wonderful man of calvary

songs.title: Faith, mighty faith, the promise sees

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Faith, mighty faith, the promise sees
And looks to God alone;
Laughs at impossibilities,
And cries “it shall be done”
And cries

It shall, it shall be done
And cries
“It shall, it shall be done”
Laughs at impossibilities
And cries, “it shall be done”

songs.title: Faithful One

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Faithful One
So unchanging
Ageless One
You’re my rock of peace
Lord of all, I depend on You
I call out to you
Again and again
I call out to you
Again and again
You are my rock
In times of trouble
You lift me up
When I fall down
All through the storm
Your love is the anchor
My hope is in you alone

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

songs.title: Father, we love you

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Father, we love you,
We worship and adore you;
Glorify your name in all the earth,
Glorify your name! Glorify your name!
Glorify your name in all the earth,

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus, we love you,
We worship and adore you;

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Spirit, we love you,
We worship and adore you.

songs.title: Fight the good fight with all thy might

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Fight the good fight with all thy might
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right
Lay hold on life and it shall be Thy joy and crown eternally.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Run the straight race through God's good grace,
Lift thine eyes, and seek his face;
Life with its way before thee lies,
Christ is the path, and Christ thy prize

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
Faint not, nor fear his arms are near,
He changeth not, and thou art dear
Only believe, and thou shalt see
That Christ is all in all to thee.

songs.title: For God so loved the world

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
For God so loved the world,
That He gave us His only Son.
And whosoever believes on Him
Shall have everlasting life.
The Lord is good! The Lord is good!

The Lord God is good,
He’s good to me.
Translation of “Sεdeε
Onyankopon d44 wiase ni”

songs.title: For God so loved this sinful world

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
For God so loved this sinful world,
His Son He freely gave,
That whosoever would believe,
Eternal life should have.

‘Tis true, oh, yes, ‘tis true
God’s wonderful promise is true,
For I’ve trusted, and tested and tried it,
And I know God’s promise is true

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
I was a way-ward, wand’ring child
A slave to sin and fear,
Until this blessed promise fell
Like music on my ear

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
The “whosoever of the Lord,
I trusted was for me;
I took Him at His gracious Word,
From sin He set me free

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Eternal life, begun below,
Now fills my heart and soul;
I’ll sing His praise forevermore,
Who has redeemed my soul.

songs.title: For I'm building, a people of power

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
For I'm building, a people of power
And I'm making a people of praise
That will move through this land by my Spirit
And will glorify my precious name
Build your Church Lord,
Make us strong, Lord,
Join our hearts, Lord, through your Son.
Make us one Lord, in your body
In the Kingdom of your Son

songs.title: For your goodness, O, my Saviour

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
For your goodness, O, my Saviour
I will love you more and more
Let the Holy Spirit teach me
How to love my Saviour more and more More and more More and more
How to love my Saviour more and more
More and more
More and more
How to love my Saviour more and more

songs.title: Gentle Jesus, meek and mild

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Gentle Jesus, meek and mild,
Look upon a little child;
Pity my simplicity,
Suffer me to come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Fain I would to Thee be brought,
Gracious Lord, forbid it not;
In the Kingdom of Thy grace
Give a little child a place.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Fain I would be as Thou art;
Give me Thine obedient heart
Thou art pitiful and kind,
Let me have Thy loving mind.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 6
Verse 7
Verse 8
sections.content:
I shall then show forth Thy praise,
Serve Thee all my happy days;
Then the world shall always see
Christ, the holy Child , in me.

sections.content:
Give me oil in my lamp, keep me burning,
Give me oil in my lamp, I pray,
Give me oil in my lamp, keep me burning
Keep me burning till the break of day.

Sing Hossana! Sing Hossana!
Sing Hossana! To the King of Kings!
Sing Hossana! Sing Hossana!

Give me joy in my heart,
Keep me praising
Give my joy in my heart, I pray;
Give me joy in my heart
keep me praising
Keep me praising till the break of day

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Give me peace in my heart,
Keep me loving
Give me peace in my Heart I pray
Give me peace in my heart, keep me loving
Keep me loving till the break of day.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Give me love in my heart, keep me serving
Give me love in my heart, I pray
Give me love in my heart keep me serving

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Glorious Lord of lords (2x)
Praise be to you forevermore

Glorious Lord of lords

songs.title: Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Glory! Glory! Glory!
Be unto the Lamb
Lift the name of Jesus,
for He’s victorious
Hail Him, Church of Jesus!
Let’s sing praises to our King,
Glory! Glory! Glory
Be unto the Lamb!
Translation of “Anuonyam, anuonyam nka Oguamaa no”

songs.title: Go, labour on, spend, and be spent

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Go, labour on, spend, and be spent
Thy joy to do the Father’s will;
It is the way the Master went,
Should not the servant tread it still?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Go, Labour on, ‘tis not for nought,
Thy earthly loss is heavenly gain
Men heed thee, love thee, praise thee not
The Master praises, what are men?

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
Men die in darkness at your side
Without a hope to cheer the tomb;
Take up the torch, and wave it wide,
The torch that lights time’s thickest gloom

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Toil on, faint not, keep watch, and pray
Be wise, the erring soul to win;
Go forth into the world’s highway,
Compel the wanderer to come in

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Toil on, and in thy toil rejoice;
For toil comes rest, for exile home
Soon shalt thou hear the Bridegroom’s voice
The midnight peal: “Behold I come!”

songs.title: Go, tell it on the mountain

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Go, tell it on the mountain
Over the hills and everywhere
Go, tell it on the mountain
That Jesus is his name

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
He possessed no riches
No home to lay his head;
He saw the needs of others
And cared for them instead

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
He reached out and touched them
The blind, the deaf, the lame;
He spoke and listened gladly
To anyone who came

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Some turned away in anger,
With hatred in the eye;
They tried him and condemned him
Then led him out to die

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
'Father, now forgive them'
Upon the cross he said;
In three more days he was alive
And risen from the dead

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
He still comes to people
His life moves through the lands;
He uses us for speaking
He touches with our hands

songs.title: God be with you till we meet again

sections.label: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.content:
Till we meet ... Till we meet ...
Till we meet at Jesus’ feet...
Till we meet ... Till we meet ...
God be with you till we meet again

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
God be with you till we meet again!
‘Neath His wings securely hide you
Daily manna still provide you;
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
God be with you till we meet again!
When life’s perils thick confound you.
Put His love arms around you;
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
God be with you till we meet again!
Keep love’s banner floating o’er you
Smite death’s threatening wave before you
God be with you till we meet again!

songs.title: God said to Abram, come and follow me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
God said to Abram, come and follow me.
I’ll lead you to a land,
That flows with milk and honey
As far as you can see I’ll give it all to thee

God’s got an army, marching through the land
Deliverance is their song, there’s healing in their hand
There’s everlasting joy and gladness in their heart
And in this army I’ve got a part

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
God asked Ezekiel, can these bones live again?
Ezekiel said, Lord you know if they can.
Then preach to these bones, say come together and stand
It’s time, we’re gonna march through this land.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
In the clouds of heaven
King Jesus shall decend
And every knee shall bow,
and every tongue confess
He’ll reign throughout this land in peace and righteousness
And I’ll be there in the army of the blessed

songs.title: God sent His Son, they called him Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
God sent His Son, they called him Jesus
He came to love, heal and forgive;
He lived and died to buy my pardon
An empty grave is there to prove
My Saviour lives.

Because He lives, I can face tomorrow
Because He lives all fear is gone
Because I know He holds the future
And life is worth the living just because He lives

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
How sweet to hold a new born baby
And feel the pride and joy he gives
But greater still the calm assurance
This child can face uncertain days because Christ lives

sections.label: Verse 3

songs.title: Gracious God you are

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Gracious God you are
We bow to worship you
Gracious God you are

songs.title: Hark! The herald-angels sing

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Hark! The herald-angels sing
Glory to the new-born King
Peace on earth, and mercy mild.
God and sinners reconciled
Joyful, all ye nations rise,.
Join the triumph of the skies;

With the angelic host proclaim
‘Christ is born in Bethlehem’

Glory to the new-born King

Christ, by highest heaven adored,
Christ, the everlasting Lord
Late in time behold him come
Offspring of a virgin’s womb
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see!
Hail, the incarnate deity!

Pleased as man with man to dwell,
Jesus, our Emmanuel.

sections.label: Verse 3

Hail, the heaven-born Prince of peace!
Hail, the sun of righteousness!
Light and life to all he brings,
Risen with healing in his wings,
Mild he lays his glory by
Born that man no more may die
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth

songs.title: Hark the voice of Jesus crying

sections.label: Verse 1

Hark the voice of Jesus crying
Who will go and work today?
Fields are white and harvest waiting
Who will bear the sheaves away
Loud and strong the Master calleth
Rich reward He offers thee
Who will answer gladly saying
Here am I, send me! Send me!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
If you cannot speak like angels
If you cannot preach like Paul
You can tell the love of Jesus
You can say He died for all
If you cannot rouse the wicked
With the judgement dread alarms

You can lead the little children
To the Saviour’s waiting arms

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
If among the older people
You may not be apt to teach
“Feed my lambs” said Christ our Shepherd
Place the food within their reach

And it may be that the children
You have led with trembling arms
Will be found among the jewels
When you reach the better land

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Let none hear you idly saying
“There is nothing I can do”
While the souls of men are dying
And the Master calls for you
Take the task He gives you gladly
Let His work your pleasure be Answer quickly when he calleth
“Here am I, send me! Send me!

Have Thine own way!

Yielded and still.

Humbly I bow

Have Thine own way!
Hold o’er my being
Absolute sway!

Living in me!

Manna from a-bove .

Nothing is too little
For His gentle care;
Nothing is too lowly
In His love to share

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Jesus loves the children,
Children such as we;
Blest them when their mothers
Brought them to His knee

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Jesus calls the children,
Bids them come and stand
In His pleasant garden,
Watered by His hand

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Lord, Thy call we answer
Take us in Thy care;
Train us in Thy garden,
In Thy work to share

In the same old way, in the same old way
The Lord is doing business in the same old way;
In the same old way, in the same old way,
The Lord is doing business in the same old way.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
In Times Like These
You need a Saviour
In times like these
You need an Anchor
Be very sure
Be very sure
Your anchor holds
And grips the solid Rock
This Rock is Jesus
Yes He’s the One
This Rock is Jesus
The only one
Be very sure
Be very sure
Your anchor holds
And grips the solid Rock.

songs.title: Into My Heart

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Into my heart, into my heart,
Come into my heart, Lord Jesus
Come in today, come in to stay
Come into my heart, Lord Jesus.

songs.title: Is There a Heart That Is Waiting

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Is there a heart that is waiting
Longing for pardon today?
Hear the glad message proclaiming
Jesus is passing this way

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Jesus is passing this way
This way, this way
Jesus is passing this way
He is passing this way today

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Is there a heart that has wandered?
Come with thy burden today;
Mercy is tenderly passing
Jesus is passing this way

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Is there a heart that is broken
Weary and sighing for rest?
Come to the arms of thy Saviour,
Pillow thy head on his Breast

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Come to thy only Redeemer
Come to His infinite love,
Come to the gate that is leading
Homeward to mansion above

songs.title: Is There Anybody Here That Loves My Jesus

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Is there anybody here that loves my Jesus?
Anybody here that loves my Lord?
I want to know, I want to know if you love my Lord.
My soul is happy when I love my Jesus
My soul is happy when I love my Lord,
I want to know, I want to know if you love my Lord

songs.title: It Is No Longer I That Liveth

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
It is no longer I that liveth, but Christ that liveth in me
It is no longer I that liveth, but Christ that liveth in me
He lives, He lives, Christ Jesus is alive in me
It is no longer I that liveth, but Christ that liveth in me.

songs.title: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
It may not be on the mountain's height
Or over the stormy sea;
It may not be at the battle front
My Lord will have need of me;
But if by a still small voice He calls
To paths I do not know
I'll answer, dear Lord, with my hand in Thine
I'll go where you want me to go

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
I'll go where you want me to go dear Lord
O'er mountain, or plain or sea;
I'll say what you want me to say, dear Lord
I'll be what you want me to be

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Perhaps today there are loving words
Which Jesus would have me to speak;
There may be now, in the paths of sin,
Some wand'rer whom I should seek,
O Saviour, if thou wilt be my Guide
Tho' dark and rugged the way,
My voice shall echo the message sweet
I'll say what you want me to say

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
There's surely somewhere a lowly place
In earth's harvest-fields so wide
Where I may labour thro’ life's short day
For Jesus, the Crucified.
So, trusting my all unto Thy care,
I know Thou lovest me!
I'll do Thy will with a heart sincere,
I'll be what you want me to be.

songs.title: It Will Come to Pass

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
It will come to pass
All His promises
They will come to pass, says the Lord Pray every day Believe in the word
For there is joy, fullness of joy

It’s not by our strength, but by Your strength
Power of the Holy Ghost
Performs wondrous works

Not our righteousness, but Your own!

The good fruit we bear.

sections.label: Verse 3

O Holy Spirit, Spirit Divine
Daily strength we ask of You
To Christ glorify

Jehovah, blessed be Your Name
All creation glorify Your great Name
Jehovah, blessed be Your Name

songs.title: Jesus Calls Us O'er the Tumult

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus calls us, o'er the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless sea;
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth
Saying, "Christian, follow Me;"

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
As of old, apostles heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home and toil and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store;
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, "Christian, love Me more."

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
"Christian, love Me more than these."

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Jesus calls us: by Thy mercies,
Saviour, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thy obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.

He shall never ever lose His power

songs.title: Jesus, Friend of My Soul

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul
Drawing me close to know
The loving Father’s desire
That keeps on seeking me

If I really meet You
I will worship You in truth
Worship You in Spirit
Never turn You down

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus Friend of my soul
I’m searching for You
Yet You are with me
Help me know You are close

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul
No longer I hear You
Help me clearly discern
You are always with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul
Has drawn me to Eternal God
I’ve known the depth of Your love
In joy I’ll worship You

songs.title: Jesus, How Lovely You Are

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Jesus, how lovely you are!
You are so gentle, so pure and so kind;
You shine like the morning star:
Jesus, how lovely you are!

songs.title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee.
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all shall be.
Perish every fond ambition,
All I’ve sought or hoped or known.
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and heaven are still my own

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Let the world despise and leave me,
They have left my Saviour, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art not, like them, untrue.
O while Thou dost smile upon me,
God of wisdom, love, and might,
Foes may hate and friends disown me,
Show Thy face and all is bright.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Man may trouble and distress me,
’Twill but drive me to Thy breast
Life with trials hard may press me;
Heaven will bring me sweeter rest.
Oh, ’tis not in grief to harm me
While Thy love is left to me;
Oh, ’t’were not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Go, then, earthly fame and treasure,
Come disaster, scorn and pain
In Thy service, pain is pleasure,
With Thy favor, loss is gain
I have called Thee Abba Father,
I have stayed my heart on Thee
Storms may howl, and clouds may gather;
All must work for good to me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Soul, then know thy full salvation
Rise o’er sin and fear and care
Joy to find in every station,
Something still to do or bear.
Think what Spirit dwells within thee,
Think what Father’s smiles are thine,
Think that Jesus died to win thee,
Child of heaven, canst thou repine.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Haste thee on from grace to glory,
Armed by faith, and winged by prayer.
Heaven’s eternal days before thee,
God’s own hand shall guide us there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission,
Soon shall pass thy pilgrim days,
Hope shall change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
Creation's voice proclaims it
For by his power
Each tree and flower
Was planned and made
Jesus is Lord! The universe declares it
Sun, moon and stars in heaven cry;
Jesus is Lord!

sections.label: Chorus

Jesus is Lord, Jesus is Lord!

For Jesus is Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
Yet from his throne eternal
In flesh he came
To die in pain
On Calvary's tree
Jesus is Lord!
From him all life proceeding
He gave his life a ransom thus setting us free.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
O'er sin the mighty conqueror
From death he rose
And all his foes shall own his name
Jesus is Lord! God sent his Holy Spirit
To show by works of power that Jesus is Lord!

songs.title: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, keep me near the cross
There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream,
Flows from Calv'ry's mountain.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
In the cross, (x2)
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the bright and morning star
Shed its beams around me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Near the Cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadow o’er me

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.

songs.title: Jesus, Let Me Ever Be

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, let me ever be Firmly grounded upon thee
Ever in thy work abide,
Ever in thy wounds reside.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
Anger I no more shall feel,
Always even, always still
Meekly on my God reclined
Jesu's is a gentle mind.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
I shall suffer and fulfil
All my father's gracious will,
Be in all alike resigned;
Jesu's is a patient mind

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
When ‘tis deeply rooted here;
Perfect love shall cast out fear,
Fear doth servile spirits bind,
Jesu’s is a noble mind.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
I shall nothing know beside
Jesus, and Him crucified;
Perfectly to Him be joined
Jesu’s is a loving mind

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
I shall triumph evermore,
Gratefully my God adore
God so good, so true, so kind,
Jesu’s is a thankful mind.

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.content:
Lowly, loving, meek and pure
I shall to the end endure
Be no more to sin inclined;
Jesu’s is a constant mind.

sections.label: Verse 9
sections.content:
I shall fully be restored to the image of my Lord,
witnessing to all mankind,
Jesu’s is a perfect mind

songs.title: Jesus, Lover of My Soul

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high
Hide me, O my saviour, hide
Till the storm of life is past
Safe into the haven guide;
Oh, receive my soul at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Other refuge have I none
Hangs my helpless soul on thee;
Leave, ah! Leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me
All my trust on thee is stayed
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Thou, O Christ! art all I want
More than all in thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind
Just and holy is Thy name
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4

songs.title: Jesus, My King, My Wonderful Saviour

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, my King, my wonderful Saviour,
All of my life is given to thee.
I am rejoicing in thy salvation;
Thy precious blood now maketh me free.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Wonderful Saviour, wonderful Saviour,
Thou art so dear, so precious to me!
Wonderful Saviour, wonderful Saviour,
My heart is full with praises to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Freedom from sin, o wonderful story –
All of its stains washed whiter as snow!
Jesus has come to live in His temple,
And with His love my heart is aglow.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus, my Lord, I’ll ever adore Thee,
Lay at Thy feet my treasures of love.
Lead me in ways to show forth Thy glory,
Ways that will end in heaven above.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
When in that bright and beautiful city
I shall behold thy glories untold,
I shall be like Thee, wonderful Saviour,
And I will sing while ages unfold

songs.title: Jesus, My Saviour, Came from On High

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, my Saviour, came from on high
To die for you, to die for me;
Sinful, unworthy though I may be,
All this He did for me.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Wonderful story, how can it be?
Jesus has died for me and for you:
He left His crown and His throne
All this He did for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Where the bright angels e’er sing His praise,
Round the white throne, round the white throne
Me from the depths, He came down to raise,
Claiming me as His own.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
What can I do my Lord to repay?
On Calvary’s tree, dying for me:
I’ll trust Thee, Lord, and e’er faithful be:
This I will do for Thee.

Filling all our hearts within

sections.label: Verse 4

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, see me at thy feet,
Nothing but thy blood can save me;
Thou alone my need canst meet,
Nothing but thy blood can save me
No! No! Nothing do I bring,
But by faith I’m clinging,
To thy cross, O lamb of God!
Nothing but thy blood can save me

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
See my heart, Lord torn with grief,
Nothing but thy blood can save me;
Me unpardoned do not leave,
Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Dark, indeed, the past has been,

Yet in mercy take me in Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
As I am, O, hear me pray,

I can ne’er remove a stain
Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Lord, I cast myself on thee,

From my guilt, O set me free
Nothing but thy blood can save me,

songs.title: Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore
Till suns shall rise and set no more

Verse 3
sections.content:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their young hosannas to His Name

sections.label: Verse 4

The prisoner leaps to loose his chains.
The weary find eternal rest,
And all the sons of want are blest.

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.content:
Let every creature rise and bring,
Its grateful honours to our King:
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth prolong the joyful strain.

Be a hallowed hour

Into every heart;
Bid the fears and sorrows

Thus with quickened footsteps
We’ll pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day

songs.title: Just as I am

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Just as I am, without one plea
But that thy blood was shed for me,
And that thou bidst me come to thee
O, Lamb of God, I come

sections.content:
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt
Fightings and fears within without
O, Lamb of God I come.

Just as I am, wretched, blind;
Sight riches, healing of the mind,
Yea all I need, in thee to find,

I will move thee,
Thou hast granted my request,

heaven,

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Land of our Birth, we pledge to thee
Our love and toil in the years to be;
When we are grown, and take our place
As men and women with our race.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Father in heaven, who lovest

all

That they may build from age to age An undefiled heritage.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Teach us to bear the yoke in youth With steadfastness and careful truth

The truth whereby the nations live.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Teach us to rule ourselves alway
Controlled and cleanly night and day;
That we may bring if need arise
No maimed or worthless sacrifice.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Teach us to look, in all our

ends,
On Thee for Judge, and not our friends;

That we, with Thee may walk uncowed

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Teach us the strength that cannot seek

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
Teach us delight in simple

things

springs;

the sun!

Him

this nation,

One

power.

Lord, Thy Word abideth

Light and joy receiveth

sections.content:
When our foes are near us

Word of consolation,
Message of salvation.

sections.label: Verse 3

When the storms are o’er us,

sections.label: Verse 4

Who can tell the pleasure,

Word of mercy, giving
Succour to the living
Word of life, supplying
Comfort to the dying!

O that we, discerning
Its most holy learning,

Evermore be near Thee!

Low in the grave he lay...
Jesus, my saviour!

Jesus, my Lord!

He arose, a victor from the dark domain,
And he lives forever with his saints to reign He arose!...
He arose! ..
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Vainly they watch his bed
Jesus, my saviour!
Vainly, they seal the dead
Jesus, my Lord!

sections.label: Verse 3

Death cannot keep his prey
Jesus, my saviour!
He tore the bars away
Jesus, my Lord!

Verse 3

Verse 5

Master speak! Thy servant heareth
Waiting for thy gracious word,
Longing for thy voice that cheereth

I am listening, Lord, for thee;
What hast Thou to say to me!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Speak to me by name O master,
Let me know it is to me,
Speak, that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and free,
Where the shepherd leads the flock
In the shadow of the rock.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Master speak! Though least and lowest.
Let me not unheard depart;
Master, speak for oh,
Thou knowest

All the yearning of my heart,
Knowest all its truest need;
Speak! And make me blest indeed.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Master, speak and make me ready,

When thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady,
Still to follow every word,
I am listening Lord, for Thee,
Master, speak, oh, speak to

me!

Frances R. Havergal

I need no other plea

‘Neath Jehovah’s dread frown,

Who tenderly brought
Me out to golden day

sections.label: Verse 2

Rock by his side, my steps were established and here I’ll abide:

Verse 4

at home and abroad,

Verse 3

Oh, the wondrous story!

Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.content:
Now I am from bondage freed
Every bond is riven
Jesus makes me free indeed,

Oh, the wondrous story;

Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.content:
Let the testimony roll,
Roll through every nation
Witnessing from soul to soul
This immense salvation
Now I know it’s full and free

Glory! glory! glory!

sections.content:
Glory be to God on high
Glory be to Jesus
He hath brought salvation nigh
From all sin He frees us;
Let the golden harps of God,
Ring the wondrous story;
Let the pilgrims shout aloud
Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.content:
Let the trump of jubilee
The glad tidings thunder,
Jesus sets the captives free,
Bursts their bonds asunder,
Fetters break and dungeons fall
Oh, the wondrous story

This salvation’s free to all

Glory! Glory! Glory!

And shall be evermore.

Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide,

Out of myself to dwell in Thy love

Upward for aye on wings like a dove,

Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of my home

eyes;
Over the river I’m coming,
Joyful my spirit replies.

Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom naught but calm is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?

and they.

sections.label: Verse 5

Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown

sections.label: Verse 6

Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?

sections.label: Verse 7

It is enough; earth's struggles soon shall cease,

In the land of light and love;
Pleasant are Thy courts below
In this land of sin and woe,
Oh, my spirit longs and faints
For the converse of Thy Saints
For the brightness of Thy face
For Thy fullness, God of Grace!

sections.label: Verse 2

Happy birds that sing and fly
Round Thy altars, O Most High!
Happier souls that find a rest
In a heavenly Father’s breast!
Like the wandering dove that found
No repose on earth around
They can to their ark repair
And enjoy it ever there.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Happy souls! Their praises flow
Even in this vale of woe;
Waters in the desert rise,
Manna feeds them from the skies
On they go from strength to strength
Till they reach Thy throne at length;
At Thy feet adoring fall,
Who hast led them safe through all.

O loving wisdom of our God!

is thy health and salvation;
Come ye who hear,
Brothers and sisters, draw near,
Praise him in glad adoration!

All that is needful hath been

All the Almighty can do

Gladly for aye we adore him!

Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying

The Mighty to save
Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save

sections.content:
Though they are slighting
Him
Still He is waiting

Waiting the penitent child to receive,
Plead with them earnestly
Plead with them gently.
He will forgive, if they only believe

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Down in the human heart
Crushed by the tempter
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore
Touched by a loving hand,
Wakened by kindness
Chords that were broken will
Vibrate once more.

Revive me, O Lord

songs.title: Revive Thy work, O Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord
Thy mighty arm make bare;

Speak with the voice that wakes the dead,
And make Thy people hear!

Revive Thy work, O Lord
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord descend,
Oh, come and bless us now!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Disturb this sleep of death;
Quicken the smouldering embers now
By Thine Almighty breath.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Create soul-thirst for Thee;
And hungering for the bread of life,
Oh may our spirit be!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Exalt Thy precious name,
And by the Holy Ghost, our love
For Thee and Thine inflame

sections.content:
Rise now upon your feet,
Put on the armor of the Lord,
There is victory for you.
There is victory for those,
Who will fight the fight of faith;
A crown awaits those who endure,
And eternal rest with Him

sections.content:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee!
Let the water and the blood,
From thy riven side which

flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
While I draw this fleeting breath
When my eyelids close in death,

When I soar to worlds unknown,
See thee on thy judgement throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in thee

songs.title: Saviour, blessed Saviour

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Saviour, blessed Saviour,
Listen whilst we sing,
Hearts and voices raising
Praises to our King;
All we have to offer,
All we hope to be,.

Body, soul, and spirit
All we yield to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Nearer, ever nearer
Christ, we draw to Thee,
Deep in adoration
Bending low the knee:
Thou, for our redemption,
Cam’st on earth to die;

Thou, that we might follow

Hast gone up on high

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Clearer still, and clearer
Dawns the light from heaven,
In our sadness bringing
News of sin forgiven;
Life has lost its shadows,
Pure the light within
Thou hast shed thy radiance
On a world of sin

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Onward, ever onward
Journeying o’er the road
Worn by saints before us,
Journeying on to God;

Leaving all behind us,
May we hasten on Backward never looking till the prize is won

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Higher, then, and higher
Bear the ransomed soul,
Earthly toils forgotten,

Saviour, to its goal;
where, in joys unthought of,
Saints with angels sing,
Never, weary, raising
Praises to their King.

Verse 3

Lord, take my life and make it wholly thine;
Fill my poor heart with thy great love divine
Take all my will, my passion, self, and pride,

sections.content:
O Holy Ghost, revival comes from thee;
Send a revival-start the work in me
Thy word declares thou will supply our need
For blessings now, O Lord,
I humbly plead.

Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling

songs.title: Speak to me, Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, that I may hear
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for you to show me your ways
That bring me eternal life
If I daily keep your ways
And I am obedient to you,
I shall be like a vessel of honour prepared for every good work.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, let me hear you
My ears are itching for your word
Your word is full of power and might
Your word shows me your good path
If my ears are opened to you
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a tree by streams of water yielding fruit in season

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord speak, let there be light
Your servant waits upon you
Waiting for your own good direction

That brings me light on my path
If I live in your light
And I am obedient to you,
I shall be like a light that shines to show the right ways in this dark world.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, speak so sweetly
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for your word that is so sweet
Which soothes and comforts the heart
If I walk in your good path
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a tasty salt on earth that heals the world of sickness

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, let me prosper
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for your very good statutes
For they would make me prosper
If your word dwells in my heart
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a kinsman redeemer who brings life to his nation.

sections.label: Verse 6

Cross
